title: 光学元件与光学平台
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/110_光学元件与光学平台.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/110_光学元件与光学平台/src.py

points.K1: 光学元件要看光、热、力、化学性质
points.K2: 按工作波段查透射曲线选材料
points.K3: 怕温度骤变：热应力会让元件裂
points.K4: 怕受力不均，也怕化学品和潮气
points.K5: 元件贵在加工，要爱惜使用
points.K6: 镀膜：真空中蒸发或溅射
points.K7: 增透膜抵消反射，高反膜加强反射
points.K8: 金属膜宽带反射，怕腐蚀不能摸
points.K9: 滤光片挡光，但不能代替防护眼镜
points.K10: 光学导轨：一根轨道串起系统
points.K11: 光学平台与隔振：稳、平、防振
points.K12: 镜架与调整台：精细定位
points.K13: 元件缺陷会拖累系统、产生杂散光
points.K14: 检查缺陷：显微镜、投影和干涉条纹
points.K15: 拿取与清洁：捏边缘，溶剂易燃
points.K16: 元件破损：工具收集，有毒晶体按危废
points.K17: 传输光纤不弯折、不踩压

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在光学平台前，平台上摆满透镜、反射镜和镜架
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of an optical table covered with lenses, mirrors and mounts.
shots.narration: 这一课讲光学元件与光学平台。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰光着手抓起一面反射镜，手指按在镜面上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student grabs a mirror with bare hands, his fingers pressing on the mirror surface.
shots.narration: 阿杰光着手，一把抓起反射镜。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 镜面上留下清晰的指纹，阿杰拿酒精棉球用力擦
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: clear fingerprints on a mirror surface, and a cotton ball soaked in alcohol rubbing hard on it. No text.
shots.narration: 留下指纹，他又拿棉球使劲擦。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拦住他，拿出手套和擦镜纸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and holds up gloves and a pack of lens tissue.
shots.narration: 小研说：镜子比你想的娇贵。

shots.section_title: 光学元件要看光、热、力、化学性质
shots.scene: 透镜、棱镜、窗口片三件透明元件，旁边一块不透明的金属挡板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lens, a prism and a window plate in clear glass, next to an opaque metal plate. No text.
shots.narration: 光学材料分透明和不透明两类。
overlay: 光学元件要看光、热、力、化学性质

shots.section_title: 光学元件要看光、热、力、化学性质
shots.scene: 好材料四个图标：吸收少、反射少、缺陷少、表面光滑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons for a good optical material, low absorption, low reflection, few internal flaws and a polished surface. No text.
shots.narration: 好材料吸收少、反射少、缺陷少。

shots.section_title: 光学元件要看光、热、力、化学性质
shots.scene: 元件被激光照射不损坏，受热受潮性能不变
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a window plate unharmed by a strong beam, with a heat icon and a humidity icon both ticked. No text.
shots.narration: 还要耐激光、耐热、耐潮。

shots.section_title: 光学元件要看光、热、力、化学性质
shots.scene: 光、热、力、化学四个图标围着一个透镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, light, heat, force and chemistry, arranged around a lens. No text.
shots.narration: 选元件，光热力化学一起看。

shots.section_title: 光学元件要看光、热、力、化学性质
shots.scene: 天平一边是性能，一边是价格
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance with a performance icon on one side and a price icon on the other. No text.
shots.narration: 性能和价格也要权衡。

shots.section_title: 按工作波段查透射曲线选材料
shots.scene: 进来的光和出去的光比较，出去占几成
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam entering a glass plate and a slightly smaller beam leaving it, with a fraction symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 出去的光占几成，叫透射率。
overlay: 按工作波段查透射曲线选材料

shots.section_title: 按工作波段查透射曲线选材料
shots.scene: 几条透射曲线：玻璃可见光全透，石英一直透到紫外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several transmission curves, ordinary glass clear in the visible range and quartz clear far into the ultraviolet. No text.
shots.narration: 做紫外实验，要选石英类材料。

shots.section_title: 按工作波段查透射曲线选材料
shots.scene: 到了较长红外，玻璃曲线掉到零，红外晶体的曲线才升起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the glass curve dropping to zero in the longer infrared while an infrared crystal curve rises. No text.
shots.narration: 较长红外玻璃不透，要用红外材料。

shots.section_title: 按工作波段查透射曲线选材料
shots.scene: 一张性质表：波段、折射率、注意事项图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank properties table with icons for wavelength range, refractive index and caution notes. No text.
shots.narration: 红外材料查表选，看清注意事项。

shots.section_title: 按工作波段查透射曲线选材料
shots.scene: 有的晶体遇水汽溶化，有的一敲就裂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one crystal dissolving in water droplets and another cracking along a straight line. No text.
shots.narration: 有的怕潮，有的易裂，要小心。

shots.section_title: 怕温度骤变：热应力会让元件裂
shots.scene: 玻璃片在热和冷之间来回，表面变形
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass plate between a hot flame icon and a cold snowflake icon, its surface slightly warped. No text.
shots.narration: 太热太冷，玻璃都会变化。
overlay: 怕温度骤变：热应力会让元件裂

shots.section_title: 怕温度骤变：热应力会让元件裂
shots.scene: 温度骤变时，元件出现裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass lens moved suddenly from hot to cold, a crack spreading across it. No text.
shots.narration: 温度骤变，最容易出问题。

shots.section_title: 怕温度骤变：热应力会让元件裂
shots.scene: 金属镜座里的玻璃受热，金属胀得多，接合处有应力箭头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass lens in a metal holder heating up, the metal expanding more and stress arrows at the contact. No text.
shots.narration: 金属和玻璃胀得不一样多。

shots.section_title: 怕温度骤变：热应力会让元件裂
shots.scene: 金属像高速路导热快，玻璃像小路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: heat running along a wide highway in metal and along a narrow path in glass. No text.
shots.narration: 金属导热快，膨胀也比玻璃大。

shots.section_title: 怕温度骤变：热应力会让元件裂
shots.scene: 中心热边缘冷的透镜，光斑变形
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lens with a hot centre and cool edge, the focused spot behind it blurred. No text.
shots.narration: 中心热边缘冷，光学性能变差。

shots.section_title: 怕受力不均，也怕化学品和潮气
shots.scene: 窗口片两侧压力不同，中间鼓起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a window plate with higher pressure on one side, bulging in the middle. No text.
shots.narration: 受力不均，元件会变形。
overlay: 怕受力不均，也怕化学品和潮气

shots.section_title: 怕受力不均，也怕化学品和潮气
shots.scene: 口径越大、压差越大，窗口要越厚
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small thin window next to a large thick window under a bigger pressure arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 口径越大、压差越大，窗口越厚。

shots.section_title: 怕受力不均，也怕化学品和潮气
shots.scene: 溶剂滴在塑料镜片上，表面发毛；盐晶窗口遇水汽溶掉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solvent drop clouding a plastic lens, and a salt crystal window dissolving in moist air. No text.
shots.narration: 溶剂伤塑料，盐晶窗口怕潮。

shots.section_title: 怕受力不均，也怕化学品和潮气
shots.scene: 盐晶元件放进带干燥剂的密封盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a salt crystal window placed in a sealed box with desiccant packets. No text.
shots.narration: 怕潮元件，干燥密封保存。

shots.section_title: 元件贵在加工，要爱惜使用
shots.scene: 玻璃研磨抛光、塑料模压、晶体慢慢生长三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a glass lens being ground and polished, a plastic lens being moulded and a crystal slowly growing. No text.
shots.narration: 研磨抛光、晶体生长，都很费工。
overlay: 元件贵在加工，要爱惜使用

shots.section_title: 元件贵在加工，要爱惜使用
shots.scene: 尺寸、材料、曲率、精度、波段、镀膜几个价格图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of icons for size, material, curvature, precision, wavelength range and coating, each adding to a price tag. No text.
shots.narration: 尺寸、曲面、精度、镀膜都影响价格。

shots.section_title: 元件贵在加工，要爱惜使用
shots.scene: 小研把镜片放回专用盒，登记使用
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts a lens back into its padded box and signs a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 贵重元件，爱惜使用，按规定登记。

shots.section_title: 镀膜：真空中蒸发或溅射
shots.scene: 反射镜、滤光片、透镜、棱镜，表面一层薄膜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mirror, a filter, a lens and a prism, each with a thin coloured film on its surface. No text.
shots.narration: 很多元件表面，镀着一层薄膜。
overlay: 镀膜：真空中蒸发或溅射

shots.section_title: 镀膜：真空中蒸发或溅射
shots.scene: 膜料变成蒸气，落到镜片上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: inside a vacuum chamber, coating material evaporating and settling onto lenses above. No text.
shots.narration: 一种是蒸发，膜料蒸气落到镜片上。

shots.section_title: 镀膜：真空中蒸发或溅射
shots.scene: 粒子撞击靶材，溅出微粒成膜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: ions striking a target plate and knocking off particles that coat the lenses. No text.
shots.narration: 一种是溅射，粒子撞靶溅出成膜。

shots.section_title: 镀膜：真空中蒸发或溅射
shots.scene: 石英晶片称重和光强监测两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a quartz crystal monitor icon getting heavier and a light meter watching transmitted light. No text.
shots.narration: 边镀边量膜厚，控制好厚度。

shots.section_title: 镀膜：真空中蒸发或溅射
shots.scene: 镀膜机有高压、真空、高温标志，未授权打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vacuum coating machine with high voltage and hot surface warning signs, an untrained hand opening it crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 镀膜机有高压高温，授权才能用。

shots.section_title: 增透膜抵消反射，高反膜加强反射
shots.scene: 眼镜片反光少；膜上下两面各反射一束光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eyeglass lens with little glare, and a thin film reflecting one beam from its top and one from its bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 增透膜上下两面，各反射一束光。
overlay: 增透膜抵消反射，高反膜加强反射

shots.section_title: 增透膜抵消反射，高反膜加强反射
shots.scene: 两束反射光峰谷相对，抵消；像两人一推一拉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two reflected waves meeting crest to trough and cancelling, beside two people pushing and pulling equally. No text.
shots.narration: 膜厚合适，两束反射正好抵消。

shots.section_title: 增透膜抵消反射，高反膜加强反射
shots.scene: 单层膜只对一个波长最好，多层膜更宽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single layer film working at one colour and a multilayer stack working across more colours. No text.
shots.narration: 单层只对一个波长，多层更有效。

shots.section_title: 增透膜抵消反射，高反膜加强反射
shots.scene: 多层高反膜把光几乎全部反回去
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a multilayer mirror coating reflecting almost all the light back, reflected waves adding up. No text.
shots.narration: 高反膜让反射光加强。

shots.section_title: 增透膜抵消反射，高反膜加强反射
shots.scene: 激光器两端的高反镜，只对窄波段特定角度有效
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser tube with high reflector mirrors at both ends, a narrow wavelength band and a fixed angle marked. No text.
shots.narration: 高反膜只对特定波长和角度有效。

shots.section_title: 金属膜宽带反射，怕腐蚀不能摸
shots.scene: 铝膜和金膜反射镜，金膜偏红外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an aluminium mirror reflecting many colours and a gold mirror reflecting infrared especially well. No text.
shots.narration: 金属膜在很宽的波段都高反射。
overlay: 金属膜宽带反射，怕腐蚀不能摸

shots.section_title: 金属膜宽带反射，怕腐蚀不能摸
shots.scene: 金属膜上覆盖一层透明保护膜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal coating with a thin clear protective layer on top. No text.
shots.narration: 金属易腐蚀，要镀保护膜。

shots.section_title: 金属膜宽带反射，怕腐蚀不能摸
shots.scene: 手指按在镜面上，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fingertip pressing on a mirror surface, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 所以镜面绝不能用手碰。

shots.section_title: 滤光片挡光，但不能代替防护眼镜
shots.scene: 宽带、窄带、截止、中性密度、偏振几种滤光片
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of filters of different tints, broadband, narrowband, cut-off, neutral density and polarizing. No text.
shots.narration: 滤光片按波长或强度挡光。
overlay: 滤光片挡光，但不能代替防护眼镜

shots.section_title: 滤光片挡光，但不能代替防护眼镜
shots.scene: 通带曲线，半高处两端标出宽度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bell shaped pass band curve with the width marked at half of its peak height. No text.
shots.narration: 宽带滤光片放过一段波长。

shots.section_title: 滤光片挡光，但不能代替防护眼镜
shots.scene: 截止滤光片：一边放行，一边截断
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a step shaped curve, light passing on one side and blocked on the other. No text.
shots.narration: 截止滤光片，一边放行一边截断。

shots.section_title: 滤光片挡光，但不能代替防护眼镜
shots.scene: 绿光激光器带着看不见的红外，截止滤光片挡掉红外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a green laser beam with a hidden dashed infrared beam alongside it, a cut-off filter removing the infrared. No text.
shots.narration: 绿光激光可能带不可见红外。

shots.section_title: 滤光片挡光，但不能代替防护眼镜
shots.scene: 光路里的滤光片和防护眼镜对比，滤光片代替眼镜打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a filter in the beam path beside laser safety goggles, the filter used instead of goggles crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 光路滤光片，代替不了防护眼镜。

shots.section_title: 滤光片挡光，但不能代替防护眼镜
shots.scene: 中性密度滤光片均匀减光，保护探测器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a grey neutral density filter dimming all colours equally in front of a light detector. No text.
shots.narration: 中性密度片均匀减光，护探测器。

shots.section_title: 滤光片挡光，但不能代替防护眼镜
shots.scene: 窄带片只放一种颜色，光度滤光片模仿人眼
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a narrowband filter passing one colour, and a filter whose curve matches an eye icon. No text.
shots.narration: 窄带只放一色，光度片模仿人眼。

shots.section_title: 光学导轨：一根轨道串起系统
shots.scene: 一根长导轨上排着立杆、支架和透镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long optical rail with posts, holders and lenses lined up along it. No text.
shots.narration: 光学导轨，一根轨道串起系统。
overlay: 光学导轨：一根轨道串起系统

shots.section_title: 光学导轨：一根轨道串起系统
shots.scene: 【实拍】松开滑块锁紧螺钉，滑到位置再拧紧（不通电、无激光）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands loosening a rail carrier locking screw, sliding the carrier along the rail and tightening it again.
shots.narration: 松开锁紧螺钉，到位再拧紧。

shots.section_title: 光学导轨：一根轨道串起系统
shots.scene: 三角、双矩形、平床三种导轨截面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three rail cross sections, a triangle, two parallel rectangles and a flat bed. No text.
shots.narration: 导轨截面有三种。

shots.section_title: 光学导轨：一根轨道串起系统
shots.scene: 双矩形导轨侧面有刻度，用开槽孔固定在台面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a double rectangular aluminium rail with a scale on its side, bolted to a table through slotted holes. No text.
shots.narration: 双矩形导轨带刻度，能固定在台面。

shots.section_title: 光学导轨：一根轨道串起系统
shots.scene: 花岗岩平床导轨很重，两人抬，戴手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heavy granite flat bed rail being lifted by two people wearing gloves. No text.
shots.narration: 平床导轨最稳也最重，多人搬。

shots.section_title: 光学平台与隔振：稳、平、防振
shots.scene: 钢台面上整齐的螺孔，镜架直接拧上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a steel optical table top with a regular grid of threaded holes, a mount being screwed on. No text.
shots.narration: 光学平台孔距相等，镜架直接拧上。
overlay: 光学平台与隔振：稳、平、防振

shots.section_title: 光学平台与隔振：稳、平、防振
shots.scene: 台面剖开，内部是蜂窝芯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway optical table showing a honeycomb core between steel skins. No text.
shots.narration: 台面里是蜂窝芯，又平又刚。

shots.section_title: 光学平台与隔振：稳、平、防振
shots.scene: 人走过地面产生振动波，气浮隔振腿把振动挡住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: footsteps sending vibration waves through the floor, pneumatic isolation legs stopping them before the table top. No text.
shots.narration: 气浮隔振腿，挡住地面振动。

shots.section_title: 光学平台与隔振：稳、平、防振
shots.scene: 【实拍】用内六角扳手把镜架底座用螺钉固定到光学平台螺孔上（不出光）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand using a hex key to bolt a mirror mount base into a threaded hole on an optical table.
shots.narration: 元件拧牢在台面，不放活动件。

shots.section_title: 光学平台与隔振：稳、平、防振
shots.scene: 平台腿旁的气管和线缆贴地固定，乱拖的线缆打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: air hoses and cables along the table legs neatly secured to the floor, loose trailing cables crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 腿旁气管线缆理顺，防绊倒。

shots.section_title: 光学平台与隔振：稳、平、防振
shots.scene: 平台很重，搬运找专业人员，不靠坐台面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer using lifting equipment to move an optical table, a student leaning on the table top crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 平台很重，专业搬运，不倚不坐。

shots.section_title: 镜架与调整台：精细定位
shots.scene: 透镜架和反射镜架夹住元件边缘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lens holder and a mirror mount gripping their optics by the edges. No text.
shots.narration: 镜架夹住边缘，把元件定在光路上。
overlay: 镜架与调整台：精细定位

shots.section_title: 镜架与调整台：精细定位
shots.scene: 可变光阑开孔变大变小，旁边滤光片架和棱镜台
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an iris diaphragm opening and closing, beside a filter holder and a prism table. No text.
shots.narration: 还有光阑、滤光片架和棱镜台。

shots.section_title: 镜架与调整台：精细定位
shots.scene: 剪式升降台转动旋钮升降，剪刀交叉处有夹手标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scissor lab jack rising as its knob turns, a pinch point warning at the crossing arms. No text.
shots.narration: 升降台能调高度，小心夹手。

shots.section_title: 镜架与调整台：精细定位
shots.scene: 千分尺推动平移台，两个叠放前后左右移
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a micrometer driving a translation stage, two stages stacked crosswise for two directions. No text.
shots.narration: 拧千分尺，平移台直线移动。

shots.section_title: 镜架与调整台：精细定位
shots.scene: 旋转台带着偏振片转一圈；测角仪绕一点转
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotation stage turning a polarizer through a full circle, and a goniometer tilting around one point. No text.
shots.narration: 旋转台、测角仪让元件转动。

shots.section_title: 镜架与调整台：精细定位
shots.scene: 倾斜调整架两个旋钮调反射镜角度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a kinematic tilt mount with two knobs adjusting the angle of a mirror. No text.
shots.narration: 倾斜调整架，微调反射镜角度。

shots.section_title: 镜架与调整台：精细定位
shots.scene: 调镜子时光束高度低于眼睛，弯腰平视光束打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person adjusting a mirror with the beam well below eye level, and a person bending down to beam height crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 调光路时，眼睛不与光束同高。

shots.section_title: 元件缺陷会拖累系统、产生杂散光
shots.scene: 元件表面划痕、麻点、崩边，内部夹杂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lens showing scratches, pits, a chipped edge and a small bubble inside. No text.
shots.narration: 用久了会有划痕、麻点、崩边。
overlay: 元件缺陷会拖累系统、产生杂散光

shots.section_title: 元件缺陷会拖累系统、产生杂散光
shots.scene: 多半因为拿放不当，或受力受热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lens dropped on a bench and a lens overheated, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 多半是拿放不当、受力受热造成。

shots.section_title: 元件缺陷会拖累系统、产生杂散光
shots.scene: 一个坏元件让整条光路的光斑变差
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one damaged lens in a row of good optics making the final spot blurry. No text.
shots.narration: 一个坏元件，拖累整个系统。

shots.section_title: 元件缺陷会拖累系统、产生杂散光
shots.scene: 缺陷处射出杂散光，射向探测器和人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a defect on a mirror scattering stray beams towards a detector and towards a person, with a warning symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 缺陷的杂散光，伤设备也可能伤眼。

shots.section_title: 检查缺陷：显微镜、投影和干涉条纹
shots.scene: 侧面打光，用显微镜看镜片表面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lens lit from the side under a microscope, a scratch glowing in the field of view. No text.
shots.narration: 清洁后侧面打光，显微镜细看。
overlay: 检查缺陷：显微镜、投影和干涉条纹

shots.section_title: 检查缺陷：显微镜、投影和干涉条纹
shots.scene: 通光区内有划痕打叉，边缘少量可接受
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lens with its central clear area marked, a scratch inside the area crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 中心通光区内，不能有划痕。

shots.section_title: 检查缺陷：显微镜、投影和干涉条纹
shots.scene: 光穿过被测件放大投到屏上，看局部明暗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: light passing through a test lens and projected onto a screen, a local dark patch showing a flaw. No text.
shots.narration: 投影到屏上，看局部明暗变化。

shots.section_title: 检查缺陷：显微镜、投影和干涉条纹
shots.scene: 拿走被测件再看一次，再移动被测件逐处检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the screen viewed again with the test piece removed, then the piece moved step by step. No text.
shots.narration: 拿走再看，排除光源问题。

shots.section_title: 检查缺陷：显微镜、投影和干涉条纹
shots.scene: 标准平面样板压在被测件上，出现直条纹和弯条纹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reference flat on a test plate under single colour light, straight fringes for flat and curved rings for uneven. No text.
shots.narration: 干涉条纹直而匀，表面才平。

shots.section_title: 拿取与清洁：捏边缘，溶剂易燃
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴无粉丁腈手套，只捏镜片边缘取出（不碰镜面）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved fingers in powder free nitrile gloves lifting a lens by its edge only, never touching the faces.
shots.narration: 戴手套，只捏边缘拿镜片。
overlay: 拿取与清洁：捏边缘，溶剂易燃

shots.section_title: 拿取与清洁：捏边缘，溶剂易燃
shots.scene: 【实拍】镜片放回分格的专用镜片盒，盒盖合上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a lens being placed into a padded compartment of an optics storage box and the lid closed.
shots.narration: 用完放回专用盒，分格存放。

shots.section_title: 拿取与清洁：捏边缘，溶剂易燃
shots.scene: 先用洗耳球吹掉灰尘，不用嘴吹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rubber air blower puffing dust off a lens, blowing with the mouth crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 先用洗耳球吹灰，不用嘴吹。

shots.section_title: 拿取与清洁：捏边缘，溶剂易燃
shots.scene: 【实拍】擦镜纸蘸少量溶剂，在镜面上单向轻轻拖过（溶剂用清水代替拍摄）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a sheet of lens tissue with a drop of liquid drawn slowly in one direction across a mirror surface.
shots.narration: 擦镜纸蘸少量溶剂，单向轻拖。

shots.section_title: 拿取与清洁：捏边缘，溶剂易燃
shots.scene: 丙酮、乙醇等溶剂瓶旁有易燃标志，远离热源火源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small solvent bottles with flammable pictograms kept away from a hotplate and an open flame. No text.
shots.narration: 清洁溶剂多数易燃，远离火源热源。

shots.section_title: 拿取与清洁：捏边缘，溶剂易燃
shots.scene: 少量倒在小瓶里，通风处使用，用完盖紧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small dropper bottle filled from a stock bottle near ventilation, the cap screwed tight afterwards. No text.
shots.narration: 少量取用，保持通风，用完盖紧。

shots.section_title: 拿取与清洁：捏边缘，溶剂易燃
shots.scene: 用过的擦镜纸丢进专门的收集容器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used lens tissues being dropped into a labelled solvent waste container with a lid. No text.
shots.narration: 用过的擦镜纸，按规定收集。

shots.section_title: 元件破损：工具收集，有毒晶体按危废
shots.scene: 镜片掉地碎了，徒手去捡打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a broken lens on the floor and a bare hand reaching for the shards, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 元件碎了，不要徒手捡。
overlay: 元件破损：工具收集，有毒晶体按危废

shots.section_title: 元件破损：工具收集，有毒晶体按危废
shots.scene: 【实拍】用镊子和簸箕把碎玻璃片收进锐器盒（用废玻璃片演示）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: tweezers and a small dustpan collecting broken glass pieces into a rigid sharps container.
shots.narration: 用工具收集，放进锐器盒。

shots.section_title: 元件破损：工具收集，有毒晶体按危废
shots.scene: 红外晶体旁有毒性标志和说明书
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an infrared crystal window next to a toxic hazard pictogram and a safety data sheet. No text.
shots.narration: 有些红外晶体含有毒成分。

shots.section_title: 元件破损：工具收集，有毒晶体按危废
shots.scene: 有毒晶体碎屑装袋贴标签，送危废暂存点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: crystal fragments sealed in a labelled bag and placed in a hazardous waste collection bin. No text.
shots.narration: 按说明书处理，碎屑按危废收集。

shots.section_title: 元件破损：工具收集，有毒晶体按危废
shots.scene: 破损情况报告老周并登记
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports a broken optic to the older man, who writes in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 元件损坏，报告负责人并登记。

shots.section_title: 传输光纤不弯折、不踩压
shots.scene: 激光设备线缆里的传输光纤剖面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway of a laser equipment cable showing a thin delivery fibre inside. No text.
shots.narration: 激光设备线缆里，有传输光纤。
overlay: 传输光纤不弯折、不踩压

shots.section_title: 传输光纤不弯折、不踩压
shots.scene: 光纤打死弯、被脚踩、被重物压，三个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three crossed out icons, a fibre cable bent sharply, stepped on by a shoe and crushed under a heavy box. No text.
shots.narration: 不打死弯，不踩，不压重物。

shots.section_title: 传输光纤不弯折、不踩压
shots.scene: 【实拍】把光纤线缆盘成大圈放在台面上（设备断电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands coiling a fibre optic cable into a large loose loop on a bench, the equipment switched off.
shots.narration: 放下时盘成大圈。

shots.section_title: 传输光纤不弯折、不踩压
shots.scene: 光纤受损处漏光冒烟，警示符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged fibre cable leaking light and giving off a wisp of smoke, with a warning symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 光纤受损可能漏光、着火，要停机报修。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 温度计、压力箭头、溶剂滴三个图标围着透镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thermometer, a pressure arrow and a solvent drop around a lens. No text.
shots.narration: 元件怕热、怕力、怕化学品。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 导轨、平台、镜架、手套和擦镜纸图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of an optical rail, an optical table, a mirror mount, gloves and lens tissue. No text.
shots.narration: 拿边缘、轻清洁，溶剂防火，光纤盘好。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个台灯和一盏紫外灯，向观众挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a desk lamp in one paw and a small ultraviolet lamp in the other, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：非激光光源与光辐射防护。
